Senior Backend Engineer (remote) working on MISUMI Americas' AI-powered digital manufacturing platform at Fictiv, building highly available backend services and event-driven, asynchronous systems. The core stack is Node.js with JavaScript/TypeScript on AWS (SQS, Lambda, EC2, RDS), with REST and GraphQL APIs over SQL and NoSQL databases. The role also centers on shipping production code with AI coding agents while owning correctness and reviewing agent-generated changes.
